title: CI traffic
description: Umbrella Flow: traffic of one configuration item from the Flow ClickHouse tables (flows, flows_1m, flows_5m, flows_1h).

options.content:
**${ci}** — Inventory DB reference `${ref}`, address `${ip}`.

Flows are matched to the item by `SrcCI` / `DstCI` = `ref` or `SrcAddr` / `DstAddr` = `ip` (either may be empty). *In* is traffic to the item, *Out* — from it. Bytes are already multiplied by the sampling rate. Panels over the raw `flows` table cover its retention (15 days by default); the long-range panel reads `${rollup}` and matches by reference only. Open from an Umbrella incident (Settings → Alerting → Grafana) to have the variables filled.

panels.title: Received by the CI
panels.description: Bytes sent to the item over the time range (raw flows).

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(Bytes) AS "In" FROM ${db}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ((DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != ''))

panels.title: Sent by the CI
panels.description: Bytes sent from the item over the time range (raw flows).

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(Bytes) AS "Out" FROM ${db}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ((SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != ''))

panels.title: Peers
panels.description: Distinct addresses the item talked to (raw flows).

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(if(((DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '')), SrcAddr, DstAddr)) AS "Peers" FROM ${db}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (((DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '')) OR ((SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '')))

panels.title: Flows
panels.description: Flow records that touch the item (raw flows, after sampling).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS "Flows" FROM ${db}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (((DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '')) OR ((SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '')))

panels.title: Traffic in / out — ${ci}
panels.description: bit/s to (In) and from (Out) the item, by reference or address (raw flows).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time,
  sumIf(Bytes, ((DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != ''))) * 8 / $__interval_s AS "In",
  sumIf(Bytes, ((SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != ''))) * 8 / $__interval_s AS "Out"
FROM ${db}.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (((DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '')) OR ((SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '')))
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Traffic in / out by reference, long range (${rollup})
panels.description: bit/s to and from the item over the aggregated table chosen in the rollup variable; matched by SrcCI / DstCI only (the aggregates keep no addresses). Pick flows_1h for months.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time,
  sumIf(Bytes, DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) * 8 / $__interval_s AS "In",
  sumIf(Bytes, SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring}) * 8 / $__interval_s AS "Out"
FROM ${db}.${rollup}
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '' AND (SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring} OR DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring})
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top talkers
panels.description: Peers of the item by volume: address, host name and Inventory DB reference of the other side.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(if(((DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '')), SrcAddr, DstAddr)), '^::ffff:', '') AS "Peer",
  any(if(((DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '')), SrcHost, DstHost)) AS "Host",
  any(if(((DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '')), SrcCI, DstCI)) AS "Peer CI",
  sumIf(Bytes, ((DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != ''))) AS "To the CI",
  sumIf(Bytes, ((SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != ''))) AS "From the CI",
  sum(Bytes) AS "Total"
FROM ${db}.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (((DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '')) OR ((SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '')))
GROUP BY "Peer"
ORDER BY "Total" DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top ports and applications
panels.description: Protocol, the lower (usually the server) port and the application Flow detected.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  multiIf(Proto = 6, 'tcp', Proto = 17, 'udp', Proto = 1, 'icmp', Proto = 58, 'icmpv6', toString(Proto)) AS "Protocol",
  least(SrcPort, DstPort) AS "Port",
  App AS "Application",
  sumIf(Bytes, ((DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != ''))) AS "To the CI",
  sumIf(Bytes, ((SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != ''))) AS "From the CI",
  sum(Bytes) AS "Total"
FROM ${db}.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (((DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '')) OR ((SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '')))
GROUP BY "Protocol", "Port", "Application"
ORDER BY "Total" DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top interfaces
panels.description: Exporter interfaces the traffic of the item crosses.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ExporterName AS "Exporter",
  InIfName AS "In interface",
  OutIfName AS "Out interface",
  any(InIfDescription) AS "In description",
  sumIf(Bytes, ((DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != ''))) AS "To the CI",
  sumIf(Bytes, ((SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != ''))) AS "From the CI",
  sum(Bytes) AS "Total"
FROM ${db}.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (((DstCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (DstAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '')) OR ((SrcCI = ${ref:sqlstring} AND ${ref:sqlstring} != '') OR (SrcAddr = toIPv6OrDefault(${ip:sqlstring}) AND ${ip:sqlstring} != '')))
GROUP BY "Exporter", "In interface", "Out interface"
ORDER BY "Total" DESC
LIMIT 20
